note: Aggregated from the Cloudflare billing and usage exports and from GraphQL containersUsageAdaptiveGroups, read on 2026-10-02. No account identifiers, names, or payment data.
containers_charge_note: 09-24 to 09-26 are in the 09-27 invoice. 09-27 and 09-28 fall in the next cycle and were read from the usage export (vCPU, memory and disk lines summed).
running_hours_method: allocatedMemory byte-seconds / provisioned memory (8 GiB) / 60 gives minutes per bucket; summed per day. Matched the billing totals.
